user_visible_response:
I understand the request as a new Codexa project for a tiny browser-only static quote board app named `codexa-bench-smoke3-01-quote-board-1780176994`.

Plan: build a static app with `index.html`, `styles.css`, `script.js`, and `README.md`. The app will show a small quote board, let users favorite/unfavorite quotes, persist favorites in `localStorage`, and provide a clean responsive UI that works by opening `index.html` directly in a browser.

Key assumptions: no backend, no accounts, no external APIs, no package install, no build step, and no deployment. Favorites are saved per browser/device only.

Task split:
1. Create static app files and README.
2. Implement quote rendering, favorite toggles, saved favorites view/filter, and localStorage persistence.
3. Add lightweight validation, including file existence checks and JavaScript syntax validation.
4. Record deferred bugs, optimizations, UX gaps, test gaps, and feature opportunities in `.head-developer/IMPROVEMENTS.md` without implementing scope-changing extras.

Validation will include commands such as `test -f index.html`, `test -f styles.css`, `test -f script.js`, `test -f README.md`, and `node --check script.js`.

Approve this plan and Codex can start one local Codex CLI implementation session.
